adjudication_history.source_quote: Manji rubni osteofiti FT i FP zgloba u smislu OA promjena.
adjudication_history.rationale: General FT OA is a target-relevant but unlocalized finding; lateral depth/extent unknown, uncertain rather than no mention. Neither osteophytes nor compartment inference supplies a positive.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Tibia femoral eklem düzeyinde kemik yapı köşelerinde osteofitik sivrileşme izlenmiştir.
adjudication_history.rationale: Generic tibiofemoral degenerative change plus gonarthrosis is relevant but does not localize/grade lateral cartilage; retain uncertainty rather than complete silence.
Differential mucoid signal lacks explicit internal-only location or definite degeneration/tear assessment; prior negative relied on an unstated surface assumption.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Предната кръстна връзка е силно хипопластична и се визуализира на топичното си място.
adjudication_history.rationale: Marked hypoplasia at expected site does not expressly establish congenital origin, intact continuity or fiber loss. Prior negative developmental interpretation was not explicit.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Από τον έλεγχο των χιαστών και πλαγίων συνδέσµων, του έσω µηνίσκου, του αρθρικού χόνδρου και του οστικού µυελού δεν παρατηρούνται αξιόλογα ευρήµατα.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: conventional global no-noteworthy-findings assessment explicitly names medial meniscus, without a suspicious tear or selective morphology exclusion. This is interpreted as report-level normality. Reader severity-qualifier objection is preserved for global QA.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Από τον έλεγχο των χιαστών και πλαγίων συνδέσµων, του έσω µηνίσκου, του αρθρικού χόνδρου και του οστικού µυελού δεν παρατηρούνται αξιόλογα ευρήµατα.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: broad named marrow assessment contains no focal exception; routine no-noteworthy-findings wording is interpreted as report-level normality, distinguished from no sinister lesion or no diffuse edema. Reader qualifier objection remains visible for global QA.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Από τον έλεγχο του προσθίου διαµερίσµατος και του εκτατικού µηχανισµού παρατηρείται οστεοµυελικό οίδηµα ως επί οστικής θλάσης (bone bruise) της έξω επιφάνειας του ∆Ε µηριαίου κονδύλου και ανάλογο στην έσω µοίρα της επιγονατίδας παρακείµενα εµπιεστικού οστεοχόνδρινου κατάγµατος.
adjudication_history.rationale: Definite patellar impaction fracture with current edema is attributed to a preceding reduced dislocation, but no acute interval is supplied. Edema can persist; keep acuity masked rather than adopt the reader acute-context inference. Separate femoral contusion stays positive.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Wearing of articular cartilage of left knee and subchondral bone marrow edema, more severe at lateral aspect of patellofemoral joint.
adjudication_history.rationale: Global knee cartilage wear with PF predominance is relevant to uncertain compartment involvement; does not assert absent medial assessment altogether or supply depth/extent.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Wearing of articular cartilage of left knee and subchondral bone marrow edema, more severe at lateral aspect of patellofemoral joint.
adjudication_history.rationale: Global cartilage wear with PF predominance leaves lateral tibiofemoral involvement/threshold unresolved; uncertain rather than not mentioned.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Изобразява се хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Лезията достига до края на менискуса, без видимо на достига до ставните хрущяли.
adjudication_history.rationale: Line reaches meniscal edge but reportedly not joint cartilage. Grade2a conclusion does not erase ambiguous edge/surface scope; prior internal-only assumption is insufficient for reliable negative.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Der Innenmeniskus im Hinterhorn und Pars intermedia leicht T2 signalangehoben (siehe z. B. 6/7).
adjudication_history.rationale: Mild T2 signal alone lacks an explicit internal-only pattern, definite degeneration or tear exclusion. Prior negative inferred internal degeneration from unspecific signal.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Osteoarthritis of right knee with joint space narrowing, bony spurs and subchondral cysts.
adjudication_history.rationale: General whole-knee OA provides target-relevant but unlocalized degenerative information; lateral involvement/depth/extent unknown.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Osteoarthritis of right knee with joint space narrowing, bony spurs and subchondral cysts.
adjudication_history.rationale: General whole-knee OA cannot establish PF threshold or absence; keep unlocalized OA uncertain rather than missing.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Linear hypointensity on T1WI in lateral tibial plateau and lateral femoral condyle, reflecting fracture without displaced bony fragments.
adjudication_history.rationale: Definite current lines with marrow/soft-tissue edema lack explicit acute injury interval; preserve the reader active-context positive as disagreement and retain timing uncertainty. Fracture site and purported contusion overlap.

adjudication_history.source_quote:
Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se stanje po rupturi ACL na tibijalnoj inserciji, koji je
degenerativno promijenjen, retrahiran uz PCL interkondilarno.
adjudication_history.rationale: Tibial-insertion rupture with retraction can indicate major injury, but the text does not quantify involved fibers or explicitly say entire ligament avulsed. Prior complete-tear morphology inference withdrawn; severity remains masked.
